packet_scope_matches_plan.evidence: This artifact corresponds to a CM-30 audit row with artifact_found=false/open and was created only to backfill packet-quality schema evidence for that listed work_order_id.

self_approval_forbidden_check.evidence: Sub-agent packets cannot approve themselves; parent architect/reviewer acceptance remains separate from executor evidence.

review_stale_after_mutation_check.evidence: Any mutation after review makes the prior review stale until rechecked; this artifact does not validate later mutations.

completed_null_rejected_check.evidence: completed:null is rejected and cannot count as evidence.

accepted_verdict_vocabulary_check.evidence: Packet verdicts must use explicit accepted vocabulary and cannot rely on vague done/ready/full completion language.

next_bounded_action_required_check.evidence: When goal_reached=false, the packet must expose an exact next bounded action; protocol/report/commit/push checkpoints are not stop reasons when the next action is known.

evidence_packet_required_fields_check.evidence: Evidence packets must identify files changed, verification results, commit/push status when required, and exact next action; report/smoke/static/test-only evidence cannot become full completion.

parent_review_required_check.evidence: Parent architect/reviewer coordinates and reviews; bounded sub-agent output is evidence, not self-approval.
